frames.F: F: +X muzzle, +Z up, X = 0 at the crown front, Z = 0 on the bore axis (mm)
frames.B: Blender metres, modelled in mm; +X = muzzle (bore parallel to X at Y = 0), +Z up, -Y = the gun's right side; origin = Grip
frames.unreal: Unreal cm = (Bx, -By, Bz) / 10; Unreal +X forward, +Y right, +Z up

width.ruling: Q1 RULED by the user 2026-10-14 ("go realistic"): K_Y 0.70, slide ~33 mm (real class); the TOP view as drawn is overruled on width only

scale.rule: real overall length (study 3.5); proportions from the sheet; rulers reported only

half_widths_mm.source: [S] TOP width profile (hp01_measured.json top.width_profile_mm_every_5); grip from the TOP lever line minus the levers [D]; K_Y = 0.700 (Q1)

parts.display: Barrel group: crown boss, front block, top rib with facets, hood under the rail, chamber block (fixed: gas-operated class)
parts.texel_class: B top (sight plane) / D front block
parts.joint: fixed to the frame through the lug (inside, not modelled); slide runs under the rib: sliding row against the slide
parts.real_pattern: rib top and upper facets belong to the fixed barrel; the facet runs out in the drawn diagonal; bore >= 2 calibres deep, 12.7 mm bore class, crown chamfer 0.8, rifling texture only [N]
parts.closeup: facets and rib lands are section-profile edges (no modifier bevel); crown is a revolve with true chamfer; bore darkening by depth
parts.revealed: chamber block + hood end face (ejection window) when the slide is back

parts.display: Short 1913-profile rail on the barrel hood (6 crossbars)
parts.joint: integral with the barrel hood (butt row if built as its own object)
parts.real_pattern: gunlib rail_1913: pitch 10.01, slot 5.24 x 3.0, square flat crossbar tops (CLOSEUP_METHOD_PLAN 2.3 'fins' lesson); sheet pitch 10.69 +-0.5 = the standard within reading error; TOP shows 5 bars: 6 kept (both sides + 3/4)
parts.closeup: slot floors in the rail's own oxide with root grime only; square crossbar tops with a 0.2-0.25 break

parts.display: Front sight: dovetailed block, sloped rear face, dot insert
parts.joint: butt in a dovetail on the rib (dovetail seam 0.2 visible)
parts.real_pattern: dovetail base 60 deg, block ~8.5 wide [N]; dot = a flush insert ring (colourless: no paint invented; a white/tritium-free dot is Q7)
parts.closeup: ADS-visible: rear face matte, serrated? NO (sheet shows smooth) -> smooth rear face with a 0.3 break

parts.display: Slide: U-section under the rib, flank flats + lower chamfer band, rear block with 7 raked serrations, rear-face slant
parts.texel_class: B rear block / C flanks / E inside rails
parts.joint: sliding on the frame rails (0.15-0.40 per side) and under the rib
parts.rear_sight: dovetailed square block on the rear block, two ears with the notch between (part of the slide object; black_oxide; texel A)

serrations.form: raised flat-topped ribs between square-bottom grooves, as drawn (crest highlight then dark groove)

parts.real_pattern: the sheet's rib count and lean are kept (they differ from the style reference's: a design delta in our favour); grooves cut through the upper facet and stop 1.5 mm above the slide bottom [S]
parts.closeup: serrations are part of the slide's 2D section/outline generator: each groove is extruded from one faired 2D profile with its crest/root lands, never a boolean through a bevelled block
parts.revealed: inside rails, recoil-guide bores, breech face (slide back)

parts.display: Slide front plate (thin band, chamfered corners, crown opening)
parts.joint: part of the slide (one object); visible seam 0.3 to the crown boss
parts.real_pattern: R6: the drawn front band spans the slide's lower band, so it moves with the slide; the crown boss stays (fixed barrel) and shows a gap when the slide is back
parts.closeup: front face catches the 3/4 key light: lapped flat, crown opening with wall

parts.display: Twin recoil guide rods + springs (revealed when the slide is back)
parts.joint: fixed to the frame/barrel lug; slide slides over them (sliding row)
parts.real_pattern: gas-operated class: two guide rods under the barrel [N]; only the forward 50 mm (exposed over the 48 mm travel) is modelled
parts.closeup: seen only in the fire clip at frame rate; LOD0 8-sided rods are enough (facet rule waived for E: flagged in the spec)
parts.revealed: forward 50 mm when the slide is back

parts.display: Frame: dust-cover front block, top band, trigger guard (square front), front strap, beavertail tang, grip seat
parts.texel_class: B tang + grip top / C guard, strap
parts.joint: slide on its rails (sliding); grip panels butt; pins butt
parts.real_pattern: investment-cast and machined: cast fillets on the guard and strap, machined flats on the top band and rails; no other pins drawn at 2.1 px/mm (a 3-4 mm pin would be 6-8 px): none invented
parts.closeup: variable radii by process (cast 1-1.5, machined 0.5); guard inner face shows a cast parting line at mid-thickness
parts.revealed: rails and the grip seat under the slide when back

parts.display: Wrap-around rubber grip: side panels (coarse pebble) inside a raised border, fine-stipple backstrap strip, groove between
parts.joint: butt on the frame grip seat (0.01-0.05)
parts.real_pattern: moulded rubber wrap, one piece; parting line along the backstrap centre; no screw visible on the sheet (none invented: the wrap is retained by the frame tang lip and a hidden screw under the panel, Q8)
parts.closeup: pebble from an HP bake (0.7-1.1 mm cells, 0.12-0.2 tall), coarse field on the panel and fine field on the backstrap; the border is real geometry 0.6 proud

parts.display: Trigger: curved blade, smooth face, 6.5 mm thick
parts.real_pattern: single-action pistol blade: 6-7 mm wide with a crowned face (R 2.5 across) [N]; ER1 lesson: real side faces + edge radius, never a flat cut-out
parts.closeup: blade section is a loft of crowned sections along the traced centre curve

parts.display: Hammer: spur (cocked as drawn), body behind the safety
parts.authority: LEFT + TOP (17 mm width at X -270)
parts.real_pattern: spur checkering as an HP-baked 0.8 mm pyramid field on the spur top only (texture class, study 3.2) [N]
parts.closeup: spur thickness tapers 9 -> 6 mm toward the tip (TOP shows the hammer narrower than its body)
parts.authority_view: LEFT + TOP (17 mm width at X -270)

parts.display: Safety/decocker lever on the slide rear (ambidextrous, flush block as drawn)
parts.real_pattern: slide-mounted safety rotating on a transverse shaft [N]; paddle with 3 grooves (real pattern; the sheet's block is too dark to show detail: grooves cut 0.25 deep, Q5)
parts.closeup: generic marks allowed: a dot pictogram pair (SAFE / FIRE) on the slide at the lever arc

parts.display: Slide stop lever (frame top, under the serrations' front), left side only in the real pattern; drawn both sides
parts.real_pattern: R7 sides: both sides kept as drawn (the sheet is a mirrored pair; an ambidextrous lever is a real option); thumb pad with 4 grooves 0.2 deep [N]
parts.closeup: ER1 lesson: no blocky stacked slab: pad dished 0.3 and grooved

parts.display: Magazine release button (left, behind the guard root): NOT drawn on the sheet
parts.real_pattern: R8 / Q3: low-profile 9 mm round button, checkered face (bake), proud 0.8 inside a 1 mm fence relief in the steel strip at the guard root; the only invented visible part, needed for the reload clip
parts.closeup: button face checkered 0.6 mm (ER1: smooth domes were called)

parts.display: Slide flank tab (sheet part, both sides; no counterpart on the style reference)
parts.joint: butt on the slide flank (inlay with a 0.3 seam)
parts.real_pattern: R9: kept as drawn as a fixed inlaid steel tab (an original design element; Q4 asks whether it should be a takedown lever)
parts.closeup: seam 0.3 visible with depth; top face slightly crowned

parts.display: Magazine: single-stack steel tube (hidden when seated), base plate visible below the grip

dims_mm.follower: visible through the top when empty

parts.real_pattern: single-stack large-calibre mag (tube ~16.5 x 34) [N]; witness holes on the tube spine (real practice) are hidden in the grip: Q9 default yes (reload-visible)
parts.closeup: base plate drop corners and the scratch fan from insertion (wear cause 'mag insertion')
parts.revealed: tube, follower, top round during reload

Steel.why: ~800 cm2 of metal at classes A-D (pistol targets) needs ~4.1 M texels at 70 % fill; 2048 holds 2.9 M: packer reports, smallest power of two that meets the classes wins

lods.rule: measured by the LOD-pop gate (bounding radius ~0.17 m vs the rifle's 0.45)

collision.SM_HP01: UCX_SM_HP01_00..03 (slide+barrel box, frame front box, grip hull, guard hull)
collision.physics: PHYS_HP01 one body on body, 2.0 kg

lod_pop.rule: d = 1.778 r / s (Unreal's 2 max(0.5 P00, 0.5 P11) r / d at 16:9, 90 deg)

pistol.why: a pistol sits 35-45 cm from the eye at the hip and 25-35 cm in an inspect; class C/D raised over the long-gun table (study 5.8 derivation, same formula)

gates.S0: this validator: 0 missing / null fields; real dims within +-5 %; camera block; every bone and socket name from gun_standard 0.3.0
gates.L1: blockout IoU LEFT >= 0.95 (RIGHT is a mirror: reported), TOP >= 0.92 (on the Q1 width); < 0.90 = stop and change the method
gates.L2: form IoU LEFT >= 0.96, TOP >= 0.93; each part on its authority view >= 0.95
gates.L3: P95 contour distance <= 2 sheet px (0.95 mm); features <= 2 sheet px; angles (grip axis, serration lean, top-line rise) <= 1 deg
gates.L5: colour report (reported, not a gate, if the user rules CLOSEUP CM-R1 for this gun; default: reported)
gates.L7: blind design judge >= 12 pairs <= 8/12; realism judges: fp35 (slide rear + grip), ADS (sights), TP 3 m, hero 3/4: at most 1 of 4 called fake by at most 1 judge
gates.B1-B10, H1, M1-M5: as GUN_BUILDING_STUDY 7.2 with the pistol's numbers (budget row pistol: LOD0 15-25k, ceiling 30k; mag 1-2k)
gates.U1-U12: as 7.4; U2 for the pistol: Transform Modify Bone slide -X moves straight back; hammer and selector turn about Y
gates.CU1: outline fairness: every traced outline is faired before extrusion (deviation to the trace <= 1 sheet px = 0.47 mm; direction change <= 12 deg between 0.5 mm segments except at declared corners; 0 second-difference jags > 0.08 mm)
gates.CU2: authored bevels: every edge set's land width within +-0.05 of the spec along its whole length (min >= 0.9 x spec: no clamp collapse); normals monotonic across each land (no stepped bevel)
gates.CU3: no slivers / torn faces: gunlib UD rule (Unreal degenerate thresholds) 0 failures; visible-face min angle >= 2 deg; 0 non-manifold; B6a twin topology from W1 on
gates.CU4: early realism ER0 at W1c on 8 rendered crops (slide rear + serrations L/R, trigger + guard, grip + slide stop, front sight + crown, hammer + safety, mag base, rail) under the frozen judge rig, 2 judges + 6 real-photo controls: pass <= 1/8 called CG on geometry by both; >= 6/8 = decisive fail: stop and change the method
gates.CU5: finish cards tuned on a swatch board first (stainless_brushed, stainless_bead, black_oxide, rubber_pebble) under the grey-card rig, AgX; stainless flat highlight P95/P5 >= 3 in fp35 crops
gates.CU6: real-pattern small parts: every part in craft_parts.json real_pattern built as ruled (trigger thickness + crowned face, grooved pads, checkered button, dovetail seams); audit lists each with a crop
gates.CU7: marks audit: only the inventory glyphs (safety dot pictograms; rail digits only if Q6 says yes); 0 text
gates.CU8: pebble and serration identity from geometry/bakes at real scale: pebble cell >= 3 texels at class B; serration crest polish follows the baked curvature, not noise

default: safety dot pictograms on the slide at the lever arc (white = SAFE, red = FIRE), 0.1 mm V-cut + fill
optional_Q6: rail digits on every 2nd crossbar (1913 practice)
marks.never: maker, model, calibre text, serials, logos
